title: AXI-to-APB Bridge Channel Translation
description: The bridge terminates AXI channels as an AXI slave, converts accepted traffic into serialized APB transfers, and becomes the sole APB master for the selected low-bandwidth peripheral.

nodes.label:
AXI Slave
Bridge + Buffers
APB Master

annotations.message: AXI channel handshakes are decoupled. Buffer depth and accepted outstanding traffic are implementation choices; the bridge must still correlate address, write data, and responses before issuing serialized APB transfers.
AXI requests and responses use independent channels. The single line is a readable topology summary, not a claim that AXI is one bidirectional wire.
One APB target is selected per transfer. APB3 and later can return PSLVERR, which the bridge maps into the corresponding AXI RRESP or BRESP error.
APB uses a one-cycle SETUP phase followed by one or more ACCESS cycles. PREADY can extend the transfer; the two-cycle path is the minimum, not a fixed latency.
